source.instrument: Agilent N9918A FieldFox VNA, 30 kHz - 4 GHz, 10,001 points, 50 ohm
source.fixture: improved SMA clamp onto the BNG feedlines; double-sided BNG, one electrode grounded as the port-2 reference

caveats: Measured on the 2018 boards, whose gaps were still Kapton-filled: electrically the gate, but not a beam-transmitting one. The 2021 free-finger dies are a different fixture, instrument and dielectric geometry; do not put the two on one axis (vault: bng-fabrication-and-load).
Not in an anechoic chamber: coupling to the surroundings may contribute above a few hundred MHz, as the thesis text notes.

The CST comparison exists for 30/50 µm only; the no-fingers CST export was never saved. Measured (connector) and simulated (feedline-end) reference planes differ, which shifts resonant features between the two.
The Smith chart shows the measured S-parameter itself (magnitude and phase as stored), not a de-embedded impedance.
